This report produces Table 1, Figures 1 to 3, Table S2 and Figures S1 to S3,
and the descriptive statistics given in their captions. 

In the figures, dashed and dotted lines mark arithmetic means. The models in
`study1_duration_models.Rmd` report geometric means, which are lower because
durations are right-skewed.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, dpi = 150)
```

```{r packages}
source("R/prepare_data.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
})
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

points <- combined_df %>% filter(modality == "Points")
stopifnot(all(is.na(combined_df$duration_sec[combined_df$modality == "Pronouns"])))

# Child labels used in the manuscript. Homesigners are numbered by age at first
# observation, as in Table 1.
child_label <- c(ABY = "ASL1", JIL = "ASL2", NED = "ASL3",
                 UCHS05 = "HS1", UCHS02 = "HS2", UCHS003 = "HS3")
```

# Coded points

```{r coded-points}
points %>%
  group_by(language) %>%
  summarise(children = n_distinct(subject), coded_points = n(),
            with_duration = sum(!is.na(duration_sec)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(caption = "Points coded in each group, and points with a measured duration")
```

# Table 1

Number of children observed at each age and, in parentheses, the number of
points they produced. Homesigners' sessions are placed in the nearest
four-month column.

```{r table-1}
ages <- c("1;06", "1;10", "2;02", "2;06", "2;10", "3;02", "3;06", "3;10")
cell <- function(k, n) sprintf("%d (%d)", k, n)

learners <- points %>%
  filter(language != "Homesign") %>%
  group_by(language, age) %>%
  summarise(cell = cell(n_distinct(subject), n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = age, values_from = cell)
per_child <- points %>% filter(language != "Homesign") %>%
  group_by(language) %>% summarise(per_child = round(n() / n_distinct(subject)), .groups = "drop")

homesign_column <- c("1;06" = "1;06", "1;10" = "1;10", "2;02" = "2;02", "2;10" = "2;10",
                     "3;00" = "3;02", "3;03" = "3;02", "3;05" = "3;06",
                     "3;10" = "3;10", "3;11" = "3;10")
homesigners <- homesign_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(Subject), Subject != "") %>%
  mutate(column = homesign_column[Age]) %>%
  count(Subject, column) %>%
  group_by(language = child_label[Subject]) %>%
  mutate(per_child = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(language, column, cell = cell(1L, n), per_child) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = column, values_from = cell)
stopifnot(!anyNA(homesigners$language))

bind_rows(left_join(learners, per_child, by = "language"), homesigners) %>%
  mutate(language = recode(language, English = "English-learners", ASL = "ASL-learners")) %>%
  select(group = language, any_of(ages), per_child) %>%
  arrange(match(group, c("English-learners", "ASL-learners", "HS1", "HS2", "HS3"))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Table 1")
```

# Figure 1

Mean number of points per observation session in each of the nine semantic
roles. Each role's count is divided by the number of sessions in the group,
so sessions in which a role did not occur count as zero. Homesigners'
sessions are counted as recording files, because two pairs of their
sessions fall in the same four-month interval.

```{r figure-1, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 10}
roles <- c("actor", "patient", "recipient", "place", "instrument",
           "source", "entity", "possessor", "location")
coded <- points %>%
  filter(!is.na(semantic_cat)) %>%
  mutate(group = recode(language, English = "English-learners",
                        ASL = "ASL-learners", Homesign = "Homesigners"))
sessions <- c(
  "English-learners" = nrow(distinct(filter(coded, language == "English"), subject, age)),
  "ASL-learners"     = nrow(distinct(filter(coded, language == "ASL"), subject, age)),
  "Homesigners"      = nrow(distinct(filter(homesign_raw, !is.na(Subject), Subject != ""), File)))
sessions

fig1_data <- coded %>%
  filter(semantic_cat %in% roles) %>%
  count(group, semantic_cat) %>%
  mutate(per_session = n / sessions[group],
         group = factor(group, levels = names(sessions)),
         semantic_cat = factor(semantic_cat, levels = c(roles, "unclear")))
fig1_data %>% group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(points = sum(n), points_per_session = sum(per_session), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 1)

fig1 <- ggplot(fig1_data, aes(x = group, y = per_session, fill = semantic_cat)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Semantic Category") +
  labs(x = "", y = "Average Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, angle = 70, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
        aspect.ratio = 1.2,
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 5, l = 10)) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE)
fig1
ggsave("figures/Figure1.png", fig1, width = 5.02 * 1.6, height = 6.26 * 1.6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# Figures 2 and 3

Density of point durations in each group, for all points (Figure 2) and for
points produced alone (Figure 3). Kernel density estimates use ggplot2's
default Gaussian kernel and bandwidth (Silverman's rule of thumb). The x-axis
ends at 8 s.

```{r figures-2-3, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
duration_density <- function(d) {
  means <- d %>% group_by(language) %>%
    summarise(mean_duration = mean(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  labels <- c("English-learners", "ASL-learners", "Homesigners")
  ggplot(d, aes(x = duration_sec, fill = language, color = language)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(data = means, aes(xintercept = mean_duration, color = language),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(x = "Duration (seconds)", y = "Density") +
    scale_color_manual(values = scales::hue_pal()(3),
                       breaks = c("English", "ASL", "Homesign"), labels = labels) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = scales::hue_pal()(3),
                      breaks = c("English", "ASL", "Homesign"), labels = labels) +
    xlim(0, 8) + ylim(0, 0.8) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 17), axis.text = element_text(size = 17),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 17), legend.text = element_text(size = 17),
          legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "lines"), legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "lines")) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(keyheight = 1.5), fill = guide_legend(keyheight = 1.5))
}
caption_stats <- function(d) d %>% filter(!is.na(duration_sec)) %>%
  group_by(language) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_s = mean(duration_sec), sd_s = sd(duration_sec),
            longer_than_8s = sum(duration_sec > 8), .groups = "drop")

timed <- points %>% filter(!is.na(duration_sec))
alone <- timed %>% filter(utt_type %in% "point_alone")

kable(caption_stats(timed), digits = 2, caption = "Figure 2: all points")
fig2 <- duration_density(timed)
fig2
ggsave("figures/Figure2.png", fig2, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

kable(caption_stats(alone), digits = 2, caption = "Figure 3: points produced alone")
fig3 <- duration_density(alone)
fig3
ggsave("figures/Figure3.png", fig3, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Table S2

Points with a measured duration, by child. Alone: percentage of the points
with a coded context. Unclear, other and no role: points whose semantic role
was coded as unclear or other, or was not coded; these points are excluded
only from the models that control for semantic role.

```{r table-s2}
per_child <- function(d) d %>% summarise(
  points = n(), context_coded = sum(!is.na(utt_type)),
  alone = sprintf("%d (%.1f)", sum(utt_type %in% "point_alone"),
                  100 * sum(utt_type %in% "point_alone") / sum(!is.na(utt_type))),
  unclear = sum(semantic_cat %in% "unclear"), other = sum(semantic_cat %in% "other"),
  no_role = sum(is.na(semantic_cat)),
  duration_s = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(duration_sec), sd(duration_sec)),
  .groups = "drop")

bind_rows(
  timed %>% mutate(child = coalesce(child_label[subject], subject)) %>%
    group_by(language, child) %>% per_child(),
  timed %>% mutate(child = "Total") %>% group_by(language, child) %>% per_child()) %>%
  arrange(match(language, c("English", "ASL", "Homesign")), child == "Total") %>%
  kable(caption = "Table S2")

timed %>% filter(language == "Homesign", is.na(utt_type)) %>% nrow()
```

The last line is the number of homesigner points with no coded context. These
points are in the all-points models but in none of the models of context.

# Figures S1 to S3

Density of point durations at each age, for each group (Figure S1), each
ASL-learner (Figure S2) and each homesigner (Figure S3). Blue dotted lines show
the mean of each panel; black dotted lines show the group's mean across ages
(Figure S1) or the mean of the three ASL-learners at that age (Figure S2). The
x-axis ends at 6 s; longer points are omitted from the densities but included
in the means and SDs.

```{r figure-s1, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
s1_data <- timed %>%
  mutate(language = factor(recode(language, English = "English-learners",
                                  ASL = "ASL-learners", Homesign = "Homesigners"),
                           levels = c("ASL-learners", "English-learners", "Homesigners")))
panel_stats <- s1_data %>% group_by(age, language) %>%
  summarise(panel_mean = mean(duration_sec), sd = sd(duration_sec), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("M = ", round(panel_mean, 2), "\nSD = ", round(sd, 2)))
group_means <- panel_stats %>% select(age, language) %>%
  left_join(s1_data %>% group_by(language) %>%
              summarise(group_mean = mean(duration_sec), .groups = "drop"), by = "language")

fig_s1 <- ggplot(s1_data, aes(x = duration_sec, fill = language)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6, color = NA) +
  geom_vline(data = panel_stats, aes(xintercept = panel_mean),
             linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8, color = "royalblue1", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(data = group_means, aes(xintercept = group_mean),
             linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = panel_stats, aes(x = 5.9, y = 0.9, label = label),
            hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 3, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ASL-learners" = "#A6DBA0", "Homesigners" = "#F4A6A6",
                               "English-learners" = "#9EC1E4"),
                    name = "language", drop = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(age ~ language, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Duration (seconds)", y = "Density") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"), legend.position = "right") +
  xlim(0, 6) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), limits = c(0, 1))
fig_s1
ggsave("figures/FigureS1.png", fig_s1, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 450)

timed %>% group_by(language) %>% summarise(longer_than_6s = sum(duration_sec > 6)) %>% kable()
```

```{r figures-s2-s3, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
# Per-child densities at each age. The y-axis extends to the highest density
# in any panel (computed on 0 to 6 s), with a minimum of 1.
child_density <- function(d, fill, age_means = FALSE) {
  d <- d %>% mutate(child = child_label[subject])
  peak <- d %>% group_by(age, child) %>%
    summarise(peak = if (n() > 1) max(density(duration_sec, from = 0, to = 6)$y) else 0,
              .groups = "drop")
  y_max <- max(1, max(peak$peak) * 1.1)
  panel_stats <- d %>% group_by(age, child) %>%
    summarise(panel_mean = mean(duration_sec), sd = sd(duration_sec), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("M = ", round(panel_mean, 2), "\nSD = ", round(sd, 2)))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = duration_sec)) +
    geom_density(fill = fill, alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
    facet_grid(age ~ child, drop = TRUE) +
    labs(x = "Duration (seconds)", y = "Density") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")) +
    xlim(0, 6) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), limits = c(0, y_max)) +
    geom_text(data = panel_stats, aes(x = 4.5, y = y_max * 0.8, label = label),
              hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3, color = "black") +
    geom_vline(data = panel_stats, aes(xintercept = panel_mean),
               linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8, color = "royalblue1")
  if (age_means) {
    age_stats <- panel_stats %>% select(age, child) %>%
      left_join(d %>% group_by(age) %>% summarise(age_mean = mean(duration_sec)), by = "age")
    p <- p + geom_vline(data = age_stats, aes(xintercept = age_mean),
                        linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8, color = "black")
  }
  p
}
fig_s2 <- child_density(filter(timed, language == "ASL"), "lightgreen", age_means = TRUE)
fig_s2
ggsave("figures/FigureS2.png", fig_s2, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 450)

fig_s3 <- child_density(filter(timed, language == "Homesign"), "coral")
fig_s3
ggsave("figures/FigureS3.png", fig_s3, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 450)
```
